component.name: Files
component.summary: Browse, organize and find your files

description.p: Files is the file manager of Telamon OS. It has tabs, a sidebar of your places and drives, icons, list, details, columns and gallery views, a preview pane, split view and Quick Look.

It works with local drives, phones, network shares, SFTP servers and the Trash. Copies and moves can be paused, cancelled and undone, and a crash or a full disk never loses your files. Search finds files across your home folder instantly.
Renamed to Telamon Explorer. Your settings and the file index move over by themselves.
